questions.q: What do these pancakes taste like?
questions.e: In the video: "Ukus je kao knedle sa šljivama" — the taste is like plum dumplings.
In the video: "Mutim štapnim mikserom da ne bi bilo grudvica" — I whisk with a hand blender so there are no lumps.

questions.q: At what temperature is it baked?
questions.e: In the video: "Ide u rernu na 200 stepeni" — it goes into the oven at 200 degrees.

questions.q: What do people get for installing the store's app?
questions.e: In the video: "ostvarujete čak 15% popusta na prvu kupovinu" — you get as much as 15% off your first purchase.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Mutim štapnim mikserom da ne bi bilo *grudvica*.
questions.e: Grudvica — a lump; here gen. pl.
Šolja — a cup; šolju — acc. case.

questions.q: Ide u rernu na 200 stepeni, a za to vreme na malo *putera* propržim 100 grama prezle i šećera.
Sve namirnice sam naravno *pazarila* u Gomexu.

questions.e: After words of quantity (šolja "cup") the genitive is needed: brašna.
The preposition u answering "where to?" takes the accusative: u rernu.

questions.q: Mutim ___ mikserom da ne bi bilo grudvica.
questions.e: Mikserom is masculine instrumental; the adjective agrees: štapnim.
The preposition sa ("with") takes the instrumental: šljivama.
